title: Generate bill separators according to width
goal: Use for to concatenate characters a given number of times.
summary: for are the starting value, the conditions for continuing execution, and the update after each round. Starting from 0, incrementing by 1 each time, continuing when the count is less than the width, the loop body is executed width times.
tasks: completes receiptDivider(width). The parameter width is a non-negative integer, indicating the required number of characters.
uses for to splice a half-width dash - to the divider in each round, and returns a string after the loop ends. When width is 0, an empty string is returned.

example.note: Seat overview uses a box to represent a seat, tablePlaces(3) will return three boxes.

hint: If the result always lacks one character, substitute width as 1 to check the loop. When the count starts from 1 and the condition is less than 1, the body of the loop will not be executed even once.
